description: Source code for a custom dashboard widget (dashlet) class 'MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet' in SuiteCRM, extending a generic chart dashlet, responsible for rendering a sales pipeline chart grouped by sales stages with dynamic data fetching and chart rendering logic.

classes.name: MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying a sales pipeline chart grouped by sales stages, with configurable date range and sales stages, extending the generic chart dashlet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing date range and title, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays options for selecting sales stages, using global app list strings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript code to render the chart, including data fetching, chart configuration, and rendering logic.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Fetches and processes chart data from the database, ordering sales stages as per selection.

methods.name: getHorizBarTotal
methods.description: Calculates total value of dataset for display or processing.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by sales stage and user, filtered by date range and sales stages.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Defines grouping fields for the SQL query, namely sales stage and user name.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares data arrays for chart rendering, including labels, data points, tooltips, and total calculation.
